_history: VERSION 1. Live 2026-11-20: Mitch, blueprint-mitch 02:37Z ("once your done it can be live"); Tony set the process d2_to_d3 live in the app 04:25Z; moved from stages/_draft/d2_to_d3 by Blueprint the same hour. Blueprint's working text: NOT reviewed by Michael (hold on questions since 2026-11-20 00:11Z); the assumptions are in ASSUMPTIONS.md and standards/ASSUMPTIONS_NOT_REVIEWED.md. Ships with the electrical 2D step OFF (Mitch 03:32Z and 03:34Z). NOTHING here has run on a model: the batch of SMOKE_TESTS.md on a scratch model comes before the first real run. Until then: WORKING DRAFT v0, REBUILT 2026-11-20 03:10Z by the D2D3_BUILD worker so that the v2 compiler takes it (Mitch, blueprint-mitch 02:37Z to 02:42Z). Not reviewed, not accepted, not synced, no work order compiled from it (dry runs only: automation/work_order_compile.py --dry-run-draft). Its state before: pack.json.bak-20261120-build. Fields starting with _ and the fields evidence / open are draft annotations, not schema. Built by automation/build_pack_d2_to_d3.py.

_deferred_kinds_note: What this stage still does not do: HVAC equipment and its sheet, gas routing (drops and stubs), low voltage (data, smoke detectors, 3-way switching detail). In both houses these arrive only in Final (EVIDENCE.md 6: HVAC and gas S 2/2; low voltage S 1/2 (Lowry)). The three kind names are Blueprint's proposal, not reviewed: NONE of them is in the app's vocabulary today (35 kinds, read 2026-11-20), so no contract can carry one yet. A work item of one of them is listed on the plan as deferred and built by nothing in this stage.

2d._enabled_note: THE SWITCH. true = one electrical layout per room is drawn and approved by a person before anything is placed. defaults.source: blueprint-intent-ui src/lib/defaults.ts (the scope of a house default)
defaults.note: As PACK V1: defaults_scope is information for whoever reviews the pack; an accepted default reaches a phase as a typed work item. The electrical defaults of this pack are NOT app defaults: they are the file ELECTRICAL_DEFAULTS.md, Blueprint's assumption, not reviewed, used only where no work item says.

_kinds_note: Every kind d1_to_d2 claims is claimed here too (a client change can be of any of them), plus its three deferred kinds. The routing is Blueprint's assumption, not reviewed.
_acceptance_note: A phase names only checks that exist in the app today (read 2026-11-20). What each phase would need beyond them: CHECKS_WANTED.md.
